PMMA (acrylic) (sphere) solid burn test; microgravity; BASS. Conditions: O2 22.1%, pressure 98.29 kPa, air display steps: 10, 3-4. Observation: Very bright sooty ball. Lots of vapor jetting. Only extinguishes when all flow stops. N2 is entraining air to flame zone. Don noted that there was no soot on the sphere, just the 'char layer'. ~ 2 minute total burn. Source: PSI-26 'As Run Test Matrix' workbook, row 6, doi:10.60555/58h4-dy80.
